comment: Shared fixture for financial_report_extractions.document_meta (docs/plans/fundamentals-coverage.md 2.5). The Python extractor derives each case's expected object from its text with deterministic regexes; the Go test (services/pkg/extractiontrust) asserts every expected object is inside the closed vocabulary and that each invalid input loses exactly its bad keys. An absent key means absent: never guess. entities: stored entity values (from prod, 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-13), lines and report titles from stored texts (2026-10-13), probes of the former-name rules, and what clean_entity / cleanEntity reduce each to; "" means the value states no name and the entity is absent.
rules: currency: from a presentation statement '(presented|expressed|reported|stated) in <US|United States|Australian|New Zealand|Canadian> dollars' -> USD|AUD|NZD|CAD; the evidence is that phrase verbatim. With no such statement, a currency-prefixed unit header (US$, A$, NZ$, C$ before million/billion/'000/m/bn) sets it, with that header as the evidence. Two distinct currencies at the winning level -> currency omitted. A bare '$' never sets a currency.

units: unit statements are '<prefix>$ Million', '$m', '$M', '$ million', '(A$ million)', '$bn', '$ billion', '$'000', '$000', 'thousands of', 'nearest dollar' / 'whole dollars' (-> units). Exactly one distinct unit value across the pages read -> that value, the first statement verbatim as the evidence; several distinct values -> units and units_evidence omitted. A figure such as '$412.6m' is not a unit statement.

entity: what the document says about itself, never about another entity. The value of the first 'Name of entity' field (the label optionally numbered as a form's item: '1. Name of Entity', '10.1 Name of entity') that is not another entity's: a field is skipped when the 3 non-empty lines before its label's line read as a control gained or lost, associates or joint ventures heading ('the Company gained or lost control over the following entities', 'Loss of Control Over Entities', 'Details of associates and joint venture entities'), or when its label's line and the 2 non-empty lines after it carry that section's labels ('(or group of entities)', 'Control gained or lost', 'Date control lost', '% holding', 'Ownership interest', 'Country of incorporation'). The value is on the label's line (after a numbered label, only when it ends like a company name: otherwise that line is the item's heading or a contents entry, '1. Name of entity and reporting period 2', and the search goes on), or is the next non-empty line when that ends like a company name and has no 'entity' in it; the first field not skipped decides, a name or none. Else the name immediately before 'ABN' on the same line (an auditor's skipped; for a trust's responsible entity, the trust named after its ABN). Else the name on the line above a line that is a registration number and nothing else ('ACN 629 071 594', 'ARSN 620 920 201', 'ABN: 87 008 670 817'): the first, in document order, that ends like a company, has no 'entity' in it, has a token that is neither a legal form nor an industry word ('Resources Limited' names no one), is not an auditor, does not start with its role and ':' or '-' ('Trustee: Perpetual Trust Services Limited'), and has none of these on the line above it: a role label (manager, registry, custodian, trustee, responsible entity, auditor, secretary, ...), except a role with only its preposition after it ('Responsible entity of'), which introduces the name under it; a registration line (a list of entities); a 'Name of entity' label (that field is the first rule's to read or skip); and it is not a labelled name ('Entity name: Cortexa Pty Ltd') with a control gained or lost heading in the 3 non-empty lines above it. When the name read is followed, after its own registration and licence lines (ABN, ACN, ARSN, ARBN, AFSL), by 'Responsible entity of' (or 'for') alone on its line and then a name with its own registration line, or by 'as (or in its capacity as) responsible entity of X', the entity is that name or X, the trust ('Charter Hall / Retail Management Limited / ACN 069 709 468 / AFSL 246996 / Responsible entity of / Charter Hall Retail REIT / ABN 34 357 213 849' is 'Charter Hall Retail REIT'). Else omitted. A name before an ACN, ARSN or ARBN on the same line is never read. A former name in brackets after the name is kept after it, and the checks above look past it ('Ocean Sciences Ltd (formerly BPH Global Ltd)'; '(previously known as X)' and '(Formerly: X)' too), unless the name is a proprietary company's ('Pty Ltd', 'Pty. Ltd.', 'Pty Limited', 'Proprietary Limited'; never the listed entity: 'Sturt Exploration Pty Ltd (formerly Axiant Resources Exploration Pty Ltd)' is 'Sturt Exploration Pty Ltd'); of two, the last is kept; every other trailing bracket is cut, and a value that starts with a former name ('(formerly BPH Global Ltd)', '(formerly BPH Global Ltd), ABN 57 009 104 330', '(formerly BPH Global Ltd) (ASX: BP8)', 'Name: (formerly BPH Global Ltd) Limited') states no name, whatever follows it. A leading 'Name:', 'Company name:', 'Entity name:' or 'of' is not part of the name. Not a name: a report title, with or without its year ('ANNUAL FINANCIAL REPORT 2026', 'FY26 Annual Report', 'Annual Report 30 June 2026', 'Appendix 4E 2026', 'INTERIM REPORT 2025/26'), a phone number ('T +61 2 8777 7777', 'Tel: +61 8 9423 8100'), a sentence about the release or the listing rules ('Authorised for release by: the Board of Ampol Limited', 'to the ASX under Listing Rule 4.3A').

abn: 'ABN' then 11 digits grouped 2-3-3-3, emitted as 'NN NNN NNN NNN', only when the ABN checksum passes: the first such ABN in the text, which is not always the document's own (CDM's annual report spells its own 'A.B.N. 17 112 870 096', so the ABN read is its manager's; nothing reads document_meta.abn yet).

period_end / period_type: the document's own period, from a period phrase '<kind> ended <d Month yyyy>' (half-year, half year, 'half- year' / 'half - year', six months, twelve / 12 months, financial year, year, or a 'half-year period' / 'six-month period' / '12-month period'); half-year and six months -> half, the rest -> annual. A range '<d1> to <d2>' or '<d1> - <d2>' ends on d2 when d2 is after d1 and the span is a half or a year, 182 or 365 days give or take 7 (an inclusive '1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026', a 52-week year): half or annual by its span, and a kind word before it must agree; any other range states no period ('Comparison of half-year ended 31 December 2025 to 31 December 2024' runs backwards), and neither does a range with an impossible date: the search goes on to the next statement or phrase. The document's reporting-period statement decides: the phrase or range right after '(current / financial) reporting period' or 'current period', with only a bracketed qualifier ('(RP)', '("current period")'), ':' or '-' and 'is', 'being', 'covers', 'for', 'the' (and 'from' before a range) between them, or the label alone on its line over its value on the next non-empty line ('1. The reporting period covers the year ended 30 June 2026.', 'Reporting period: half-year ended 31 December 2025', 'Current period / From 1 August 2025 to 31 July 2026', 'Current reporting period: / 01 July 2025 - 30 June 2026'); only when the label's line holds nothing before it but an item number ('1.', '1.1', 'Item 1', 'A.', 'a)', '(a)'), a bullet ('-', '*', '•', '·'), a form feed, 'The', 'This' or 'Details of (the)' ('Dividends paid during the reporting period:' is prose), and never after 'previous', 'prior', 'comparative', 'corresponding' or 'preceding' (within 40 characters, a label wrapped over lines included), nor when it is a table's header row: a label over its value on the next line, under another period's label alone on its line, its value followed by another period phrase or range ('Previous corresponding period / Current period / Year ended 30 June 2025 / Year ended 30 June 2026'). Without one, the latest month a period phrase ends in ('financial year ended 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026', or '- 30 June 2026', ending on its range's d2), skipping a phrase that ends on or after the report date (when the extractor is given one) and a phrase its line introduces as the comparison ('previous corresponding period: year ended 30 June 2025', 'compared with the', '(pcp:', 'Comparisons are made to the') or as still to be reported ('to be disclosed in the financial report for the half-year ended 31 December 2025'; 'to be' or 'will be' then disclosed, reported, included, presented, released, lodged or recognised; with a report date, only for a period that ended 6 or more calendar months before it), within 80 characters and with no '.', ',' or ';' between; when the report date is more than 7 calendar months after that latest month (a late document), the month the most phrases end in instead, the later on a tie; the month's first phrase gives the day, and the type is the one most of that month's phrases give (the first's on a tie). 'as at <date>' is not a period end. An impossible end in the phrase the period is read from (the statement's, or the chosen month's first) withholds period_end and period_type.

report_kind: first match in this order anywhere in the pages read: 'Appendix 4E' -> appendix_4e, 'Appendix 4D' -> appendix_4d, 'Annual Report' -> annual_report, 'half-year report' / 'half year report' / 'half-year financial report' / 'interim financial report' -> half_year_report, 'results announcement' / 'profit announcement' / 'results for announcement to the market' -> results_announcement; then, in the document's head only (its first five non-empty lines, each starting within the first 400 characters): when a head line that reads as a heading (not a sentence) names the document a presentation ('Investor Presentation', 'FY26 Results Presentation'), a Pillar 3 disclosure, a transcript or a webcast -> other; else 'results release' / 'full year results' / 'half year results' (not followed by presentation, briefing, webcast, call or transcript) -> results_announcement; else omitted, and the title decides. 'presentation currency', 'basis of presentation' and a sentence announcing a presentation or webcast never make a document 'other'.
